page_title: shortshort: AI clip maker that cuts long videos into shorts

sources.entry: shortshort - Turns one long talk, podcast or course into up to 20 vertical 9:16 shorts with word-by-word captions. #freemium

summary.name: shortshort
summary.one_liner: shortshort is an AI clip maker that turns one long video (up to 2 GB) into vertical 9:16 shorts with word-by-word captions, optionally scheduled to YouTube.
use_cases: Turn a long talk or podcast into YouTube Shorts
Repurpose a course recording into short clips
Add word-by-word captions to vertical video
Schedule short clips to publish over several weeks
Reframe a landscape video to 9:16 following the speaker's face
summary.what_it_does: The web app transcribes the whole uploaded video word by word and proposes short passages that form complete sentences, each targeted at a length of 15 to 90 seconds. Each proposed short is cropped to 9:16 (or 4:5 for Instagram) with a face-tracking crop and automatic zooms between x1.0 and x1.6, while slides and wide shots stay full-frame. Captions are timed on every word in one of four styles: Spotlight, Impact, Karaoke or Minimal. Users can edit the AI's clips, titles, descriptions and captions before exporting an MP4, and can schedule exported 9:16 shorts to a connected YouTube channel.
notable: Face tracking crop that follows the on-screen face, with automatic zooms
Word-by-word timed captions in four styles
Scheduled publishing to YouTube from a calendar
Sentence-aware clip selection checked against the transcript
caveats: Free plan limited to 3 shorts per video with a small watermark; paid plans (Studio at €79/month before VAT) remove it and allow up to 20 shorts
TikTok publishing is in early access and Instagram is not connected (download MP4 instead)
Face tracking does not identify the speaker, so two-person shots may stay on the listener
AI analysis sends video or transcript to Google Gemini or OpenAI, outside the EU
